test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Change the voice of the following sentence.

It is going to be constructed by them within a few weeks.

options.text: They are going to construct it with a few weeks.
They are going to construct it within a few weeks.
​They are going to construct something within a few weeks.
They are going to constructed it within a few weeks.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice sentence, "It is going to be constructed by them within a few weeks."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "they" at the beginning of the sentence.
 
• Change the passive verb form "is going to be constructed" to "are going to construct" (future continuous active).
 
• Ensure the object "it" remains at the end of the sentence, followed by the time phrase "within a few weeks."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They are going to construct it within a few weeks."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"They are going to construct it with a few weeks." – Incorrect preposition ("with" instead of "within").
 
• **Option 3: **"They are going to construct something within a few weeks." – Incorrect as it uses "something" instead of the specific object "it."
 
• **Option 4: **"They are going to constructed it within a few weeks." – Incorrect tense ("constructed" instead of "construct").
